comment: Flow-through ESD lines (electronics/tools/flowthru.py, tools/tests/test_flow_through.py): connector pad, the ESD part's two pads (connector side first), the next part's pad.  Every USBLC6 here carries two nets, the connector side (net) and the protected side (net2): the PC port's pair (U4), the DATA lead's pair (U8) and the camera's SPI (U12/U13, since BN-3; TP18 is SCK's test pad, on the lead side).
